metrics.name: System Model
metrics.gotcha: SystemInfo.model gives the lowercase form.

metrics.name: Active Licenses Expiring Within 30 Days Count
Active Licenses Expiring Within 5 Days Count

metrics.name: Device Firmware Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: Networks[].Devices[].join(', ', [join(': ', [`Device Name`, to_string(DeviceName)]), join(': ', [`Firmware`, to_string(firmware)])]) | sort(@)

metrics.name: Hardware Device List
metrics.jmesPathQuery: Networks[].Devices[?networkId].{Model: model, DeviceName: DeviceName, NetworkName: NetworkName}
metrics.gotcha: The top-level key for Meraki devices is Networks[].Devices[] — NOT NetworkDevices (which does not exist). Always traverse via Networks[]. Confirmed by Global metric id=104678 and recipe verification on System B (2026-05-22).

metrics.name: Open (No Auth) SSID Count
metrics.gotcha: SSIDs are nested under Networks[].SSIDs — not top-level Ssids[]. The recipe pattern Ssids[?authMode == 'open'] will return null. Always traverse via Networks[?Type=='wireless'].SSIDs[].

metrics.name: Privileged User Count
metrics.gotcha: Privileged is the string 'Yes' not boolean true. Filter: Privileged == `Yes` (backtick-quoted string in JMESPath).

metrics.name: Firmware Version
metrics.gotcha: Quoted key required in JMESPath because 'version' is a reserved word in some JMESPath implementations. Use Firmware.current."version" not Firmware.current.version. The id=521 metric provides an alternate path SystemInfo.Firmware.Version which may differ on some firmware versions.

metrics.name: Group Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: Groups[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Name`,to_string(name)]), join(`: `, [`Email`,to_string(email)]), join(`: `, [`Member`,to_string(sort(member[].name))]), join(`: `, [`Group Type`,to_string("group-type")])]) | sort(@)

metrics.name: Interface Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: Interfaces[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Name`, to_string(name)]), join(`: `, [`Vdom`,to_string(vdom)]), join(`: `, [`Type`,to_string(type)]), join(`: `, [`IP & Subnet`,to_string(ip)]), join(`: `, [`Role`,to_string(role)]), join(`: `, [`VLAN ID`,to_string(vlanid)])]) | sort(@)

metrics.name: Model Number
metrics.gotcha: Two paths exist for model/version info. id=223 uses Firmware.current."platform-id" (the Fortinet API path). id=521 uses SystemInfo.Firmware.Version for the firmware string. These are complementary — use 223 for model, 224/521 for firmware version.

metrics.name: Routing Policy Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: IPV4Routing[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Type`, to_string(type)]), join(`: `, [`Gateway`, to_string(gateway)]), join(`: `, [`IP Mask`, to_string(ip_mask)]), join(`: `, [`Interface`, to_string(interface)])]) | sort(@)

metrics.name: User Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: Users[].join( `, `, [join(`: `, [`Name`, to_string(name)]), join(`: `, [`Vdom Name`,to_string(sort(vdom[].name))]), join(`: `, [`Type`,to_string(type_r)]), join(`: `, [`Profile`,to_string(accprofile)])]) | sort(@)
metrics.gotcha: Users[] contains local VPN/firewall auth accounts only — NOT admin accounts. FortiGate admin accounts (System > Administrators) are NOT present in the dataprint. AdminUsers key returns null on all validated systems. Admin account audit requires manual FortiGate GUI review.

metrics.name: Device Resource Utilization (CPU & Memory)

metrics.name: Configuration Changes Pending
metrics.gotcha: Key is hyphenated — JMESPath requires quoting: Configuration."pending-changes-exist".

metrics.name: Software Version
metrics.gotcha: The key is hyphenated — JMESPath requires quoting: SystemInfo."sw-version". Without quotes the hyphen is interpreted as subtraction and the query returns null.

metrics.name: Zones With Gateway Anti-Virus Disabled Count
Zones Without Intrusion Prevention Count
metrics.gotcha: IntrusionPrevention is boolean False (not string 'false') — the Global metric uses backtick `false` which is JSON false in JMESPath. The id=106916 variant uses `Network.Zones[?IntrusionPrevention==False]` (Python-style) and also returns a valid result. Use backtick-quoted boolean for strict JMESPath compliance.
